input: Find churches holding Vacation Bible School (VBS) in 2025 or 2026 (search "VBS 2026", "VBS 2025" and "vacation bible school" with each town name; small and rural churches too) for kids and teens in Weaverville, Barnardsville, Marshall, Mars Hill and Hot Springs, NC. Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
